LESSON: JOHN THE BAPTIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: John the Baptist

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on John the Baptist. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is the message of John the Baptist still relevant today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the teachings of John the Baptist
2. practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: JOHN THE BAPTIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
John the Baptist helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: JOHN THE BAPTIST
Study John the Baptist like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the teachings of John the Baptist

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the teachings of John the Baptist. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the teachings of John the Baptist.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “John the Baptist” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the teachings of John the Baptist. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

What this means
In this part you learn to practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to John the Baptist in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what John the Baptist is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “John the Baptist” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the teachings of John the Baptist)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to John the Baptist in your own words. (skill: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach John the Baptist to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the teachings of John the Baptist.
3. Practise this skill: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist.
4. Make one local Kenya example of John the Baptist from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for John the Baptist: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study John the Baptist?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the message of John the Baptist still relevant today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what John the Baptist means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the teachings of John the Baptist.
5. Be able to: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
